records.body:

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Glad to have Bright Logistics on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Bright Logistics* just created a workspace on team.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, Team plan active and the getting started call was held as scheduled [calendar:d0f7c90d], so intent exists. But Felix never replied to three outreaches [email:85e74307, email:11f9ef91, email:8635102b], no project, no invite, no tickets. Post-call inaction for 3 days suggests low unaided odds within 8 days.

draft.subject: Following up on our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on, so this is my last nudge for now.

The quickest way to see where Wrenfield fits for Bright Logistics is one real project with your actual tasks -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to set up that first project with you on a short call this week -- 15 minutes, and we can use a live workstream of yours.

Best,
Priya
